scenarios.name: help
scenarios.stdout:
Configuration-driven project verification: init -> verify -> one project decision

Usage: harness-gate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  podman-capture     Explicit read-only Podman evidence capture; executes the selected project's trusted host
  report-verify      Verify one pinned saved result and its evidence without loading a project
  report-dashboard   Combine latest report hot spots, selected trends and observed commit changes, offline
  report-history     Render one metric's history from explicitly pinned completed reports, offline
  report-export      Export a completed, pinned HTML report for optional artifact delivery; never evaluate policy
  explain            Explain a registered machine failure, CLI error or configuration diagnostic code without loading a project
  findings           Consume completed reports as diagnostic findings; never evaluate policy
  cache-clear        Clear authenticated local step-cache entries; retain unknown or modified files
  plugins            Validate an explicit plugin lock and prepared offline artifacts without a project
  quality            Advanced evidence evaluation and integration; use verify for project decisions
  compat             Run the versioned serial compatibility launcher and migration tools
  adapter            Advanced signed adapter protocol; use verify for project orchestration
  doctor             Check local tools, configuration, Git, and test database access
  lifecycle-cleanup  Explicitly reconcile a retained lifecycle service by exact fence and invocation
  cleanup            Inspect and reclaim stale Harness-Gate resource leases
  scope              Show changed files and the verification components they select
  secrets            Scan file names for high-confidence credential patterns
  audit              Run deterministic architecture rules and write review_context reports
  verify             Run configured execution and quality gates for one blocking project decision [alias: check]
  hook               Run the staged, fast verification profile used by pre-commit
  parse-logs         Extract one trace's error context from JSON Lines logs
  config             Validate or inspect flow and optional quality configuration
  schema             Generate artifacts for the workflow configuration model
  step               Run one configured full-profile step after secrets and audit gates
  init               Initialize flow and reference quality packs; provision trusted inputs before verify
  presets            List the generic preset and an explicitly selected external catalog
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --plugin-store <PATH>        Offline prepared plugin store. No downloads or installation are implicit
      --plugin-trusted-key <PATH>  Operator-selected Ed25519 public key JSON; never read from project config
      --presets-dir <PATH>         Directory containing a reviewed external catalog.json and preset files
      --color <COLOR>              Control colored terminal output [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --project-root <PATH>        Override automatic project root discovery
      --config <PATH>              Override the repository workflow configuration file
      --replay-state-dir <PATH>    Host-owned durable nonce ledger shared by verify, quality collect and adapter run
      --step-cache-dir <PATH>      Enable local step reuse in an exclusively host-owned directory outside the project
  -h, --help                       Print help
  -V, --version                    Print version

Project workflow:
  harness-gate init --preset rust-api --presets-dir /path/to/GateProbes/presets
  harness-gate config check
  harness-gate verify --profile ci --all

Reference presets generate flow + quality configuration. Provision trusted collector
state, signed requests and keys before verify; see generated QUALITY.md.
Ecosystem identity is configuration/pack data; collectors measure, Rust decides.
Advanced interfaces: quality evaluate and adapter run (explicit trusted inputs).

scenarios.name: init
scenarios.stdout:
Initialized preset "generic" in <PROJECT_ROOT>/.harness-gate
Project directory (display only): <PROJECT_ROOT>
From that project directory, run:
  harness-gate config check
    Validate the generated configuration.
  harness-gate doctor
    Execute the declared dependency checks.
  harness-gate verify --plan --all
    Inspect the configured default-profile plan without running gates, commands or collectors.
Quality remains opt-in; no quality policy was generated.
After reviewing the configuration and prerequisites, run harness-gate verify --all to execute verification.

help: harness-gate explain E1000
Next: harness-gate init --preset generic
Minimal flow.toml shape:
version = 2

[project]
name = "my-project"
default_profile = "full"
hook_profile = "hook"

[paths]
reports = ".harness-gate/reports"
audit_config = ".harness-gate/audit.toml"
secrets_config = ".harness-gate/secrets.toml"

[scope]
unmatched = "all"
rules = [{ patterns = ["**"], components = ["project"] }]

[[steps]]
id = "project.diff-check"
label = "Git whitespace check"
component = "project"
profiles = ["full", "hook"]
program = "git"
args = ["diff", "--check"]
cwd = "{root}"
log = "git_diff_check.log"
timeout_secs = 60

Then run: harness-gate config check
